task.instruction: Search for an open-source project related to 'climate change data visualization' on GitHub and report the project with the most stars.

final_answer:
The project with the most stars is **resource-watch/resource-watch**, with **73 stars**. I got this from a GitHub repository search for 'climate change data visualization', sorted by most stars. Its topics are react, typescript, nextjs, mapbox and datasets. The search returned 545 repositories.

The next highest were Beckybams/AI-Enhanced-Climate-Education-Tools- (40 stars), WorldWindLabs/AgroSphere (20 stars) and akshaysonvane/Climate-Change-Data-Analytics-Visualization (11 stars).

I didn't open the repository page, so I haven't read its description.

judge.rationale: GitHub search results for “climate change data visualization” are sorted by Most stars, showing resource-watch/resource-watch first with 73 stars.
